paper.title: Information-Regularized Attention for Visual-Centric Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a paradigm for multimodal learning, yet remain unstable due to object hallucination, weak visual grounding, and catastrophic forgetting after full-parameter instruction tuning. We claim these failures result from a lack of explicit control over visual representation learning during the standard next-token prediction objective. As a result, visual embeddings thus become passively optimized and prone to injecting redundant or spurious signals. To counter t

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在视觉中心推理中容易出现物体幻觉、视觉 grounding 不稳、全参指令微调后遗忘的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态训练机制改进。它把问题归因于标准 next-token objective 对视觉表征缺少显式控制，关注点接近 native multimodal pretraining 中“视觉信息如何进入语言层”的训练动态。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Information-Regularized Attention，一种随机注意力机制，在 Transformer 中间层显式调节注入 hidden states 的视觉信息量。方法通过局部重参数化把视觉表征不确定性转化为样本独立的局部噪声，从而压制冗余或虚假视觉信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示除任务性能外，还量化 embedding 属性；IRA 产生更平滑的曲率轨迹，并抑制部分异常表征行为。未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 数量或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses object hallucination, unstable visual grounding, and forgetting after full-parameter instruction tuning in visual-centric VLM reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal training-mechanism modification. It frames the failure as insufficient control over visual representations under the standard next-token objective, which is relevant to how visual signals are injected into language backbones.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Information-Regularized Attention, a stochastic attention mechanism that explicitly controls the amount of visual information entering intermediate Transformer hidden states. A local reparameterization turns uncertainty in visual representations into data-point-independent local noise.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports both downstream performance evaluation and embedding diagnostics. IRA is claimed to yield smoother curvature trajectories and suppress spurious representation behavior, but model size, data scale, baselines, and numerical gains are not specified.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 embedding 诊断即可；把视觉注入当随机信息瓶颈有意思，但摘要里的因果链还不够干净。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and embedding diagnostics; treating visual injection as a stochastic information bottleneck is interesting, but the causal story is not yet clean.

paper.title: HKVLM: Faithful Reasoning Grounding by Binding Language Queries to a Frozen Detector
paper.abstract: Many visual requests -- ``the object to open this bottle'', ``the person not wearing a helmet'' -- require reasoning, not just category matching. Pure open-vocabulary detectors need an explicit phrase; vision-language models (VLMs) can reason yet ``see but mis-speak'', attending to the right region but returning the wrong box or label. We argue this is a \emph{binding} failure: in coordinate-as-text VLMs localization passes through the autoregressive head, coupling it to language generation; in

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在视觉 grounding 中“语言推理意图”和“真实区域定位”绑定不稳的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM grounding 架构改造。它关注的不是多模态预训练本身，而是推理式视觉指代表达如何避免经过自回归语言头后产生坐标或标签错配。
summary.technical_approach: HKVLM 将定位从语言生成路径中移出：冻结的语言对齐检测器产生 class-agnostic region proposals，冻结语言模型把复杂请求编码为 referential query embeddings，再用轻量 alignment hook 在共享嵌入空间中做 contrastive retrieval 和 bipartite assignment；另有 perception-grounded faithfulness veto 用于抑制不可信绑定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模、baseline 或数值结果。实验主张应当围绕推理式 grounding 请求，如“能打开瓶子的物体”“没戴头盔的人”等，而不是单纯类别匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unreliable binding between language-level reasoning intent and visual region localization in VLM grounding.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an architectural treatment of faithful VLM grounding rather than a pretraining recipe. The useful idea is to decouple localization from the autoregressive language head to reduce coordinate and label misbinding.
summary_en.technical_approach: HKVLM removes localization from the language generation path. A frozen language-aligned detector produces class-agnostic proposals, a frozen language model encodes reasoning requests into referential query embeddings, and a lightweight alignment hook performs contrastive retrieval and bipartite assignment in a shared embedding space. A perception-grounded veto filters unfaithful bindings.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation appears to focus on reasoning-grounded visual requests rather than plain category matching.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图即可；“不要让 AR 头吐坐标”这个判断对 native VLM 设计有一点参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram; the useful prior is that AR coordinate generation is a brittle interface for native VLM grounding.

paper.title: Clearer Sight, Fewer Lies: Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are prone to hallucination as their generation preferences are insufficiently calibrated to visual evidence, causing them to fall back on linguistic priors, rather than faithful grounding. In this work, we start from an empirical observation: when query-relevant visual evidence is explicitly strengthened using the model's own attention, generation becomes more accurate, suggesting that many failures do not arise solely from missing perception, but from an

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型（MLLM）因生成偏好未与视觉证据充分校准、过度依赖语言先验导致的幻觉问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将视觉证据强度纳入偏好对齐的约束维度，而非仅关注响应质量，为MLLM幻觉缓解提供了新的优化方向
summary.technical_approach: 提出Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization（OPPO），先通过模型自身注意力增强查询相关视觉证据构造不同强度的证据视图，再对比同一忠实响应在强/锚定/弱证据视图下的表现，将朴素视觉偏好转化为有序的视觉证据对齐目标
summary.experiments: 原摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据集规模、对比基线及定量提升幅度，仅通过经验观察验证了增强视觉证据可提升生成准确性

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses MLLM hallucinations caused by generation preferences being insufficiently calibrated to visual evidence, leading to over-reliance on linguistic priors
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that first incorporates visual evidence strength into preference alignment constraints, rather than only focusing on response quality, providing a new optimization direction for MLLM hallucination mitigation
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization (OPPO): first constructs evidence views of varying strength by amplifying query-relevant visual signals via the model's own attention, then contrasts the same faithful response across strong/anchored/weak evidence views to turn naive visual preference into ordered visual-evidence alignment
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model parameters, training dataset size, baselines, or quantitative improvement margins; only empirical observations confirm that enhancing visual evidence improves generation accuracy

recommendation.zh: 多模态幻觉对齐的小改进，核心是把证据强度放进偏好对比，可作为后训练 ablation 的弱参考，不用深读
recommendation.en: Minor tweak to multimodal hallucination alignment that injects evidence strength into preference ranking; useful only as a weak signal for post-training ablations, no deep read needed

paper.title: GUICrafter: Weakly-Supervised GUI Agent Leveraging Massive Unannotated Screenshots
paper.abstract: Data, as the fundamental substrate of modern intelligence, has greatly driven the development of current foundation models. Naturally, researchers aim to extend this paradigm to the domain of GUI agents, hoping to build strong GUI agents through a similar paradigm. However, GUI agent data cannot be directly harvested from the internet, making it costly and difficult to collect at scale. As a result, current GUI agents suffer from poor cross-device generalization and limited visual grounding abil

summary.core_problem: GUI agent 缺少大规模、低成本、细粒度的训练数据，导致视觉定位能力弱，跨设备、跨界面泛化不稳。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值主要在数据构造和训练信号设计。它把未标注截图、网页 DOM/交互元素、移动端自动采集的 GUI 元素转成可验证的弱监督训练任务，接近“GUI 领域的预训练数据引擎”。对基座研究员的启发不在 GUI 任务本身，而在如何为多模态 agent 构造可扩展、低人工标注成本、带可验证奖励的预训练阶段。
summary.technical_approach: GUICrafter 采用两阶段训练。第一阶段是 weakly-supervised GUI pretraining：从真实网页和已有移动端 GUI 数据中抽取可交互元素，把按钮、输入框、链接等交互信号转换为 meta-task，让模型根据截图完成定位和操作，并用可验证奖励更新模型。这里的关键取舍是不用人工写完整任务轨迹，也不依赖 MLLM 自动生成高噪声标签，而是利用界面自带的交互结构提供监督。第二阶段使用少量高质量人工标注 GUI 任务做强化微调，继续用 RLVR/GRPO 类算法优化实际任务表现。课程学习的设计比较清楚：先让模型广泛看界面、学元素 grounding，再用更接近真实任务的数据校准多步行为。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖六个不同平台的 GUI benchmark，包括 Mind2Web 和 ScreenSpot-Pro 等。论文报告 Stage 1 单独就能显著提升 grounding accuracy；Stage 1 加 Stage 2 后，视觉定位和泛化进一步提升。一个值得注意的结果是，GUICrafter 使用的 Stage 1 与 Stage 2 总训练数据量约为 UI-TARS 的 0.1%，但达到可比或更好的结果。在相同人工标注数据量下，它也超过 GUI-R1 等已有 RLVR 方法。这个结果说明收益主要来自弱监督数据规模和训练信号质量，而不是简单堆人工轨迹。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 GUI 数据困境的拆解，Method 中 Stage 1 的数据生成流程、meta-task 构造和奖励设计，以及实验部分关于 Stage 1/Stage 2 的消融。若只关心预训练，可以跳过具体 GUI benchmark 细节，集中看未标注截图如何变成可训练样本，以及为什么可验证交互信号比自动 caption/action 标注更稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the data bottleneck for GUI agents: fine-grained GUI grounding and multi-step action data are expensive to annotate, and current agents generalize poorly across devices, layouts, and application domains.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining lies in the data pipeline rather than in GUI automation as an application. GUICrafter shows how large collections of unlabeled screenshots and webpages can be converted into weakly supervised, reward-verifiable training instances. This is useful for thinking about multimodal agent pretraining, especially when the environment contains latent supervision signals such as DOM structure, clickable regions, input fields, and interaction affordances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a two-stage curriculum. Stage 1, called weakly supervised GUI pretraining, extracts interaction signals from crawled webpages and mobile GUI data, then turns them into meta-tasks that ask the model to locate and act on the corresponding GUI elements. The model receives verifiable rewards when its action matches the interactive target, and training is performed with an RLVR-style algorithm based on GRPO. Stage 2 adds a smaller amount of high-quality human-annotated GUI task data for reinforcement fine-tuning. The key design choice is to avoid noisy MLLM-generated labels and expensive full-trajectory annotation, using structured GUI affordances as the supervision source instead.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on six GUI benchmarks spanning different platforms, including Mind2Web and ScreenSpot-Pro. Stage 1 alone improves grounding accuracy, and the full two-stage curriculum further improves both grounding and generalization. The reported data efficiency is the main empirical point: the total amount of Stage 1 and Stage 2 training data is about 0.1% of UI-TARS, while achieving comparable or better performance. Under the same amount of human-annotated data, GUICrafter also outperforms prior RLVR-based GUI agents such as GUI-R1.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the problem formulation in the introduction, then focus on the Stage 1 data construction pipeline, the meta-task design, and the reward mechanism. The most useful ablations are those separating weakly supervised pretraining from the second-stage high-quality reinforcement fine-tuning. Readers focused on foundation-model training can skip most benchmark-specific GUI details.

recommendation.zh: 弱监督 + 课程学习的思路对数据稀缺的 agent 领域有参考，主要看 §3 两阶段训练设计和无标注信号的构造方式
recommendation.en: The weak-supervision + curriculum-learning pipeline is instructive for data-scarce agent domains; focus on §3 two-stage training design and how unlabeled signals are constructed.

paper.title: Understanding How MLLMs Describe Artworks Using Token Activation Maps
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) describe artworks with remarkable fluency, yet the visual reasoning behind their outputs remains opaque. When an MLLM names a style, identifies a subject, or recognizes an iconographic symbol, does it ground each claim in the relevant region of the canvas, draw on an undifferentiated visual signal, or rely primarily on textual priors? We study this using the Token Activation Map (TAM), which produces, for each generated token, a heatmap isolating the visu

summary.core_problem: 分析多模态大模型在描述艺术作品时，不同生成 token 是否真的基于画面中的相应视觉证据。
summary.importance: 贡献是 MLLM 可解释性分析，重点在 token 级视觉 grounding 的差异，而不是提出新的 VLM 预训练目标或评测基准。艺术作品场景较窄，但问题本身对理解视觉-语言模型的视觉依赖程度有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Token Activation Map 为每个生成 token 构造热力图，尽量隔离该 token 对应的视觉证据，并减少前文上下文干扰。作者将 token 分为常见视觉对象、风格描述、元数据、图像学符号和情感表达五类，比较不同语义类别的 grounding 模式。
summary.experiments: 实验基于一个覆盖多个时期和流派的绘画集合。摘要称 MLLM 的视觉 grounding 随 token 语义类别显著变化，并观察到模型会尝试识别作品和艺术家，且在某些情况下准确率更高；未给出具体模型、样本量和数值指标。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Bari Aldo Moro 和 University of Zurich。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether multimodal LLMs ground different tokens in artwork descriptions to the relevant visual regions of the canvas.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an interpretability analysis of token-level visual grounding in MLLMs. The art domain is narrow, but the question is relevant to understanding when VLM outputs are visually grounded versus driven by language priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors apply Token Activation Maps to produce a heatmap for each generated token, aiming to isolate token-specific visual evidence from prior-context interference. They analyze grounding across five semantic token types: common visual objects, style descriptors, metadata, iconographic symbols, and affective expressions.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses a curated set of paintings across periods and genres. The abstract reports that grounding varies substantially by token semantics and that MLLMs attempt artwork and artist identification with higher accuracy in some cases, but it does not provide model names, dataset size, or detailed quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of Bari Aldo Moro and University of Zurich.

recommendation.zh: 艺术域偏窄，但 token 级 grounding 分类值得扫一眼；只看方法定义和按语义类别拆分的结果即可。
recommendation.en: The art domain is narrow, but the token-level grounding split is worth a quick look; read only the TAM setup and the semantic-category results.

paper.title: Staying VIGILant: Mitigating Visual Laziness via Counterfactual Visual Alignment in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend large language models (LLMs) with visual perception, enabling joint reasoning over images and text. Despite inheriting strong reasoning capabilities from LLMs, they remain prone to hallucinations that contradict their visual inputs. Mechanistic studies indicate that this weakness stems from visual laziness: MLLMs encode the correct visual evidence internally, but overly rely on strong language priors during response. Existing alignment methods, suc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 MLLM 对视觉输入“看见但不用”的问题。模型内部可能已经编码了正确视觉证据，但解码时仍被语言先验主导，产生与图像矛盾的回答。标准 DPO 只优化最终文本偏好，可能奖励由文本捷径得到的正确答案，因此不能稳定压制 visual laziness。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 VLM post-training 和 native multimodal alignment 有启发。它把多模态幻觉从“感知失败”进一步拆成“视觉证据是否参与了生成决策”的问题。这个视角比单纯做更大偏好数据或更强 judge 更接近训练目标本身：如果模型在遮掉视觉信息后仍然同样自信，那么正确输出也可能不是视觉 grounded 的。对预训练研究的间接价值在于，它提供了一种衡量和训练跨模态信息使用的目标，可用于检查视觉 token、视觉编码器和 LLM 解码过程之间是否真的形成因果耦合。
summary.technical_approach: VIGIL 的核心做法是在偏好优化中加入 counterfactual visual alignment。训练时构造一个 blind state：通过 masking visual attention，让模型无法访问视觉证据，只保留文本指令。然后比较 seeing state 与 blind state 下的响应分布，最大化两者之间的 Visual Information Gain。这样做的目标不是简单让模型更偏好 winning answer，而是要求 winning answer 的置信度来自图像条件；如果模型在看不见图像时仍然对答案很自信，就会被惩罚。与标准 DPO 相比，VIGIL 约束了“答案如何得到”，而不只约束“答案是否被偏好”。与引入外部工具或模块化视觉系统不同，它不改模型结构；与在线 RL 视觉 token 选择不同，它是 offline 训练，计算和稳定性成本更低。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 VIGIL 在 7B 到 72B 的不同 MLLM 架构上都有稳定收益，且更强、更大的基座模型收益更明显。一个重要结果是数据效率：只使用对比基线 25% 的偏好数据，就能达到或接近竞争性方法的表现。作者还观察到 zero-shot referring expression comprehension 提升，且没有使用显式 bounding box 监督，说明这种反事实视觉约束可能促使模型形成更好的空间 grounding。由于给定全文片段没有完整表格，具体 benchmark 分数和逐项提升幅度不宜过度外推；可确认的实验结论是跨规模有效、数据更省、并带来一定的空间定位泛化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries 中对 visual laziness 的概率解释：标准 DPO 为什么会强化语言先验，以及 blind state 为什么能暴露这种 shortcut。方法部分需要关注 Visual Information Gain 的定义、blind attention mask 的实现位置、VIGIL loss 与 DPO loss 的组合方式。实验部分优先看三类结果：25% 数据效率对比、7B–72B 跨架构扩展、zero-shot referring expression 的无框监督提升。若只关心基座预训练，可把它当作一种跨模态信息利用诊断目标，而不是普通幻觉修复方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual laziness in multimodal LLMs: the model may encode the relevant visual evidence, yet still rely on language priors during decoding and produce answers that contradict the image. Standard DPO optimizes preference over final text outputs, so it can reward correct-looking answers that were obtained through textual shortcuts rather than visual grounding.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to multimodal post-training and to the broader question of whether visual tokens causally influence generation. Its useful contribution is the shift from outcome-only alignment to evidence-sensitive alignment. If a model remains confident after visual evidence is removed, then even a correct answer may not be visually grounded. This gives a concrete training and diagnostic signal for studying the coupling among the visual encoder, visual tokens, and the LLM decoder.
summary_en.technical_approach: VIGIL introduces counterfactual visual alignment into preference optimization. During training, it constructs a blind state by masking visual attention, preventing the model from using image evidence while preserving the text instruction. The model is then optimized to increase the Visual Information Gain between the normal seeing state and this blind counterfactual state. The intended effect is to make high-confidence preferred responses depend on the visual input. Cases where the model remains confident without the image are treated as blind-confidence failures. Compared with DPO, the method constrains how the answer is derived, not only whether the final text is preferred. Compared with tool-based or modular perception systems, it does not change the architecture. Compared with online RL for visual token selection, it is an offline objective and should be easier to train stably.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent improvements across MLLMs from 7B to 72B parameters, with larger gains on stronger foundation models. A notable data-efficiency result is that VIGIL can match competitive baselines using only 25% of their preference data. The authors also report improved zero-shot referring-expression comprehension without explicit bounding-box supervision, suggesting that the counterfactual visual constraint can encourage spatial grounding. The provided text does not include full benchmark tables, so exact per-benchmark deltas should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the Introduction and Preliminaries, especially the explanation of why DPO can reinforce language-prior shortcuts. Then read the method section for the definition of Visual Information Gain, the implementation of the visual-attention mask, and how the VIGIL term is combined with the preference loss. In the experiments, prioritize the 25% data-efficiency comparison, the 7B-to-72B scaling results, and the zero-shot referring-expression analysis. For foundation-model researchers, the most useful angle is its role as a training objective and diagnostic for cross-modal evidence use, not merely as a hallucination mitigation recipe.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练对齐的研究员可重点看其反事实视觉约束的设计，§3的几何约束公式可直接借鉴到预训练损失函数中。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal pretraining alignment should focus on its counterfactual visual constraint design; the geometric loss in §3 can be directly adapted to pretraining objectives.

paper.title: An LMM for Precisely Grounding Elements in Documents
paper.abstract: Visual grounding in documents is a crucial ability for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in areas such as document understanding, deep research and document error detection. However, existing approaches exhibit poor grounding precision in text-rich document images, often failing to accurately locate the critical document elements needed for reliable reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce PreciseDoc, an LMM specifically designed for precise element grounding and can be further optimized for Do

summary.core_problem: 提升大多模态模型在文本密集型文档图像中的元素级精确定位能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是文档 LMM 的定位数据构造和训练范式，属于多模态理解的专门能力建设。它对 VLM 预训练的可迁移启发在于：文档场景需要细粒度坐标监督，普通图文对齐不足以支撑可靠 grounding。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PreciseDoc，并构建两条可批量生产训练数据的流水线，生成带细粒度坐标元数据的高质量文档，包括带相机效果的合成手填文档。训练目标从单文本定位扩展到真实功能型定位，例如在简历中定位个人信息，并进一步服务 Document VQA。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练样本规模、baseline 和具体提升幅度。实验声称模型可进一步优化 Document VQA，但可验证细节需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve element-level precise grounding for large multimodal models on text-rich document images.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a document-focused LMM training and data-construction approach. Its transferable lesson for VLM pretraining is that document grounding requires fine-grained coordinate supervision; generic image-text alignment is usually not enough.
summary_en.technical_approach: PreciseDoc uses two data-generation pipelines to mass-produce high-quality documents with fine-grained coordinate metadata, including synthetic hand-filled documents with camera effects. The training setup goes beyond locating single text spans and covers functional localization, such as finding personal information in CVs, with possible downstream optimization for Document VQA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training-data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. It states that the model can be further optimized for Document VQA, but the concrete evidence requires the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 文档 grounding 数据工程味较重；只看数据生成流水线即可，作为 VLM 坐标监督的备查。
recommendation.en: This is mostly document-grounding data engineering; skim the data-generation pipeline as a reference for coordinate-supervised VLM training.

paper.title: Faithful Grounded Visual Reasoning via Learned Proxy-Tokens
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in Visual Question Answering (VQA), yet their "black-box" nature hinders deployment in critical domains. Grounded Visual Reasoning (GVR) approaches attempt to improve interpretability by explicitly couple textual rationales with visual grounding information, which are typically textual coordinates. This mechanism lacks a learnable semantic link to the visual features, often resulting in a semantic-spatial gap where the mod

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型的接地视觉推理方法采用文本格式坐标作为定位信号，与视觉特征缺乏可学习的语义关联，存在语义-空间鸿沟，易生成与图像证据无关的幻觉坐标。
summary.importance: 提出基于可学习离散proxy token的视觉grounding机制，缓解MLLM坐标幻觉问题，同时构建ComposerGCoT合成数据集用于方法验证。
summary.technical_approach: 在MLLM架构中引入一组可学习的离散proxy token，作为直接索引图像隐空间的符号指针，使模型能够将视觉区域表示为可寻址、可语义操作的集合，替代传统文本坐标生成方式。
summary.experiments: 构建合成数据集ComposerGCoT用于训练与验证，在接地视觉推理任务上，相比基于文本坐标的基线方法能够减少无依据的坐标幻觉，提升推理结果的视觉忠实度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing grounded visual reasoning approaches for MLLMs use text-formatted bounding box coordinates as localization signals, which lack learnable semantic links to visual features, creating a semantic-spatial gap and causing hallucinated coordinates unaligned with actual image evidence.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a visual grounding mechanism based on learnable discrete proxy tokens to mitigate coordinate hallucination in MLLMs, alongside the synthetic ComposerGCoT dataset for method validation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces a set of learnable discrete proxy tokens into the MLLM architecture as symbolic pointers explicitly indexing the image latent space, allowing the model to represent visual regions as addressable, semantically manipulable sets, replacing conventional text coordinate generation.
summary_en.experiments: The synthetic ComposerGCoT dataset is constructed for training and evaluation. On grounded visual reasoning tasks, the method reduces ungrounded coordinate hallucination and improves visual faithfulness of outputs compared to text-coordinate baselines.

recommendation.zh: MLLM视觉grounding的常规改进，用可学习离散proxy token替代文本坐标绑定视觉区域，无多模态建模范式创新，知道思路即可。
recommendation.en: Routine MLLM visual grounding improvement replacing text coordinates with learnable discrete proxy tokens; no paradigm-level multimodal modeling insight, just note the design choice.

paper.title: SPOT-E: Test-Time Entropy Shaping with Visual Spotlights for Frozen VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often underperform on evidence intensive tasks because decisive visual evidence are small, localized, and easy to overlook, leading to failures in evidence readout even when high-level reasoning is intact. Prior inference-time visual interventions can improve grounding without retraining, but they are largely open-loop and lack a mechanism to verify whether highlighted evidence is actually used. We study answer-span prediction entropy as a model-internal feedback si

summary.core_problem: 解决冻结 VLM 在证据密集型视觉问答中容易忽略小而局部的关键视觉证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 推理时干预方法：用模型内部的 answer-span entropy 作为反馈信号，尝试让视觉 spotlight 不只是突出区域，而是被模型实际用于回答。对预训练研究的价值主要在于提供一种观察 VLM grounding 失败的内部信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPOT-E，一种 plug-and-play test-time 方法。它为每个样本生成 question-conditioned visual spotlights，并通过轻量优化调整 spotlight；核心是 entropy-shaping objective：降低答案不确定性，同时保留 baseline 中高置信 token，避免单纯 entropy minimization 导致 shortcut collapse。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、baseline 或提升幅度；方法设定是 frozen VLM，不进行参数级再训练，优化发生在测试时的视觉 spotlight 生成或调节阶段。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包括 Shuicheng Yan；题录未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failures of frozen VLMs on evidence-intensive tasks where the decisive visual clue is small, localized, and easily ignored.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a test-time intervention for VLM grounding. Its most relevant point for foundation-model researchers is the use of answer-span entropy as an internal signal, together with a correction for shortcut confidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPOT-E generates question-conditioned visual spotlights and optimizes them per instance with a lightweight test-time procedure. The key design is entropy shaping: reduce answer uncertainty while preserving high-confidence baseline tokens, so that low entropy is less likely to come from shortcut collapse.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmarks, VLM sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. The setup keeps the VLM frozen and performs instance-level visual intervention at inference time.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Shuicheng Yan; no institutional metadata is provided in the prompt.

recommendation.zh: 只看 entropy-shaping 的定义和失败案例即可；它是 VLM grounding 信号设计的弱但有用证据。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-shaping definition and failure cases; it is a modest but useful signal-design study for VLM grounding.

paper.title: See First, Answer Later: Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment via Sufficiency-Driven RL
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate strong text reasoning with visual inputs, yet their responses can be inconsistent with the underlying images, indicating ineffective utilization of visual evidence during inference. The prevailing training paradigm relies on large-scale caption-based pretraining for general alignment, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to enable instruction following and complex reasoning. However, such pretraining provides only weak v

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MLLM 在回答视觉问题时“看了图但没真正用好图”的问题。更具体地说，现有训练流程通常先做图文预训练，再做指令微调和 RL，但预训练阶段主要依赖短 caption，监督信号偏粗，模型容易学到场景级对齐，却学不到对细粒度属性、关系、局部区域和题目相关证据的稳定提取能力。结果是在推理时，模型更像是在做 P(a|q) 的语言先验补全，而不是可靠地做 P(a|v,q)。作者想解决的不是单个 benchmark 上的答题技巧，而是把“先找足够的视觉证据，再作答”变成一个独立训练目标，并把它放在 pretrain 与 post-train 之间，作为专门补强视觉 grounding 的中间阶段。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两点。第一，它提出了一个清楚的训练接口：把视觉感知能力的补强从任务级回答监督里拆出来，单独优化一个 question-conditioned evidence policy。这种做法对多模态预训练很有启发，因为它不是继续堆更密的 caption，也不是直接在答案上做更强监督，而是引入一个中间变量，把“看见什么”与“如何回答”分开。第二，它给出了一种较低标注成本的路径：利用现成 QA 数据，通过 frozen blind reader 判断证据是否足以恢复答案，从而把 answer supervision 转成 evidence supervision。这个思路对预训练—后训练接口、latent reasoning、以及多模态 RL 信号设计都有参考价值。量级上，它更像是一个训练范式上的中等强度贡献，而不是基础架构改写；价值在于训练目标设计和阶段划分比较干净。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 VEPA，Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment。作者把原来的直接回答分解成两步：先由 MLLM 根据图像和问题生成文本形式的 visual evidence，再由一个只看问题和证据、完全不看图的 blind reader 去恢复答案。形式上，相当于把 P(a|v,q) 分解为 P(e|v,q) 和 P(a|e,q)。这里 e 被当作信息瓶颈，训练目标要求它同时满足两个条件：一是 sufficiency，即给定问题后，证据里要有足够信息让 reader 推出正确答案；二是 visual dependence，即证据必须真的依赖图像，而不是把答案直接泄露出来，或者退化成模板化空话。

训练上作者采用 GRPO 来优化 evidence generation policy。每个样本会生成一组候选 evidence，由 group-relative 的方式做相对奖励学习。奖励设计是全文最关键的部分，不只是“reader 答对就给分”。作者显式加入了几类约束来避免训练走偏：其一，防止 answer leakage，避免模型直接把答案或近似答案塞进 evidence，导致 reader 成为形式上的验证器；其二，惩罚重复、冗余、退化的 evidence，避免 RL 常见的 verbosity 或 pattern collapse；其三，强调 sufficiency 而不是最终 answer generation，把视觉 grounding 与回答策略解耦。这样做的原因很明确：如果直接对最终答案做 RL，模型仍可能靠语言先验、题目模式或 shortcut 获得奖励，无法保证视觉证据真的被编码。

从训练流程看，VEPA 被放在 caption pretraining 之后、SFT/RL 之前，属于一个中间对齐阶段。它不要求额外的人类 dense caption 标注，而是复用现有 VQA/QA 数据。与“直接用更长 caption 继续预训练”相比，VEPA 的差异在于监督是 question-conditioned 的。也就是说，模型不是被要求穷举描述整张图，而是学习围绕当前问题抽取足够且必要的视觉证据。这比静态 dense caption 更接近推理时的真实信息需求，也更节省表示带宽。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法部分能确认的实验结论是：VEPA 在多类视觉要求较高的评测上都优于标准训练 recipe，覆盖 knowledge-intensive VQA、compositional VQA、fine-grained perception 和 holistic multimodal evaluation，并且收益不仅出现在单一 backbone。作者还强调，增益来自视觉感知增强，而不是额外任务监督，因为训练只引入了 evidence-level RL 目标，没有增加新的人工标注类型。

全文片段里没有给出完整表格数字、参数量和数据规模，因此不能编造具体提升幅度。但从作者描述的 ablation 重点可以提炼出几条关键信息：第一，blind reader 作为冻结评估器是必要的，它让奖励聚焦在“证据是否足够”，而不是让同一个模型自洽打分；第二，answer leakage 抑制项是必要的，否则 evidence 会退化成隐式答案通道；第三，性能提升在 OOD 数据上仍能保留，说明学到的不是 benchmark-specific 的答题模板，而是更稳定的视觉 grounding。若阅读全文，最值得核对的是主表里不同 benchmark 的提升分布、reward 各项消融、以及 evidence 质量的定性案例，因为这些决定了方法到底是在提升感知，还是只是在改变输出风格。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读方法设计，而不是逐行抠公式。建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminary，抓住作者为什么要把视觉证据单独建模，以及 sufficiency / visual dependence 这两个约束分别在防什么问题。然后重点看方法部分里 reward 设计和 GRPO 训练细节，尤其是如何定义 answer leakage、如何处理重复和退化 evidence、group sampling 怎么做。实验部分优先看三类内容：主结果表、reward/reader/阶段位置的消融、以及 evidence 可视化案例。阅读时间大约 25 到 40 分钟。如果你关心多模态预训练接口，值得额外想两个问题：一是 evidence 作为文本瓶颈会不会限制视觉信息上限；二是这种中间阶段能否推广到视频、语音或 unified multimodal pretraining。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a persistent failure mode in MLLMs: they answer visual questions with weak grounding, even when the image is available. The authors argue that the standard recipe—caption-based pretraining followed by instruction tuning and RL—builds only coarse alignment. Short captions emphasize salient objects and global scene summaries, but they do not train the model to reliably extract fine-grained, question-relevant evidence such as attributes, relations, and small regions. As a result, inference often drifts toward language-prior-driven answering rather than genuine image-conditioned reasoning. The paper tries to fix this by introducing an explicit intermediate objective: before learning how to answer better, train the model to produce sufficient visual evidence for the question.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the main contribution is not a new VQA trick but a cleaner training decomposition. The work inserts a dedicated stage between multimodal pretraining and post-training, and optimizes a question-conditioned evidence policy instead of relying on answer supervision to indirectly improve perception. That is a useful design pattern for multimodal foundation models: separate 'what visual information should be extracted' from 'how to produce the final answer.' A second contribution is the supervision mechanism. The method reuses existing QA data and converts answer labels into evidence-level rewards through a frozen blind reader, avoiding the need for dense human annotations. The impact is moderate but real: this is a training-objective and stage-design contribution, with implications for multimodal grounding, latent-variable formulations, and RL signal design at the pretrain/post-train boundary.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, VEPA (Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment), factorizes answering into two steps. First, the MLLM generates textual visual evidence conditioned on the image and the question. Second, a frozen blind reader—an LLM that does not see the image—receives only the question and the generated evidence, and tries to recover the ground-truth answer. In probabilistic terms, the paper rewrites direct answering as a decomposition through a latent bottleneck e: an evidence policy P(e|v,q) followed by a reasoning policy P(a|e,q). The bottleneck is intentional. It forces the model to externalize the visual content that is actually needed for answering.

The optimization target is built around two properties. Sufficiency means the evidence should contain enough information for the blind reader to infer the answer. Visual dependence means the evidence must genuinely come from the image rather than from question priors or direct answer leakage. To train the evidence policy, the paper uses GRPO. For each sample, the model generates a group of candidate evidence sequences, and learning is driven by relative rewards within the group.

The reward design is the critical part. The paper does not simply reward the reader for getting the answer right. It adds constraints to prevent degenerate solutions: penalties against answer leakage, so the evidence cannot collapse into a disguised answer channel; penalties against repetitive or low-information evidence, so RL does not reward verbosity or templated outputs; and a decoupling between grounding and final answer generation, so the optimization pressure stays on evidence quality rather than downstream response style. This is the main difference from direct answer-level RL, where the model can still exploit shortcuts from language priors. Compared with replacing captions by dense descriptions, VEPA is also different in supervision structure: the evidence is question-conditioned, not a static attempt to describe the whole image. That makes it closer to actual inference-time information needs and more bandwidth-efficient than generic dense captioning.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text content, the paper reports consistent gains over the standard training recipe across several visually demanding settings, including knowledge-intensive VQA, compositional VQA, fine-grained perception, and broader multimodal evaluation. The improvements are said to hold across different backbones, which matters because the claim is about training strategy rather than a backbone-specific trick.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, model sizes, or dataset scales, so precise numbers should not be invented. Still, the experimental story is clear. First, the frozen blind reader is important because it turns answer supervision into a sufficiency test for evidence, instead of letting the same model self-validate. Second, anti-leakage reward terms are necessary; otherwise the evidence channel can degenerate into direct answer transmission. Third, the gains transfer to out-of-distribution settings, which supports the claim that VEPA improves grounding rather than merely fitting benchmark-specific answer patterns. When reading the full paper, the most important checks are: how gains distribute across perception-heavy versus reasoning-heavy benchmarks, how strong the ablations are for each reward component, and whether the qualitative evidence examples truly show better visual extraction rather than just longer outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, so the goal is to understand the training idea rather than every implementation detail. Start with the Introduction and Preliminary sections. They explain why caption pretraining is insufficient and why the paper introduces a latent evidence variable. Then focus on the method section, especially the reward construction: how sufficiency is measured, how answer leakage is detected, and how repetitive evidence is discouraged. In experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, the ablations on reward components and blind-reader design, and the qualitative evidence examples. Expected reading time is around 25–40 minutes. If you work on multimodal pretraining, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether a textual evidence bottleneck limits the ceiling of visual information, and whether the same intermediate stage could be generalized to video, audio, or unified multimodal pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 定义和 ablation；若控制干净，它支持“先证据对齐再推理”的 VLM 后训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the reward definition and ablations; if the controls are clean, it supports a useful VLM recipe of evidence alignment before reasoning.

paper.title: LOCUS: Local Visual Cue Search for Enhancing Fine-Grained Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain unreliable on fine-grained visual perception, even when high-resolution inputs preserve the necessary local details. We identify this limitation as visual context rot: decisive evidence may exist in the full image, yet fail to be reliably selected and used amid redundant visual context. We propose LOCUS (LOcal visual CUe Search), a training framework that teaches MLLMs to internalize local evidence search through a verifiable proxy task. During tra

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 在细粒度视觉感知中，即使输入保留局部细节，也无法稳定选择并使用关键局部证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/MLLM 训练方法创新，提出“visual context rot”这个诊断，并把细粒度感知瓶颈从分辨率不足转向局部证据搜索失败；对 native multimodal pretraining 和视觉 token 使用效率有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: LOCUS 在训练时提供一个 local crop 作为 visual cue，并要求模型在完整图像中恢复该局部证据的位置；训练信号是基于 IoU 的 reward。这个 cue 只在训练时使用，推理时仍保持标准 image-question 接口，目标是让模型内化局部证据搜索策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在细粒度感知、幻觉、通用理解和推理 benchmark 上验证，提升 localization-sensitive visual understanding，同时保持广泛能力；还做了 attention analysis，显示模型更会关注局部线索。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode where MLLMs cannot reliably select and use decisive local visual evidence for fine-grained perception, even when the image contains the required details.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM/MLLM training-method contribution. Its useful framing is “visual context rot”: the bottleneck is not only input resolution, but failure to search and bind local evidence. That is relevant to native multimodal pretraining and visual token utilization.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOCUS provides a local crop as a visual cue during training and optimizes the model to recover its spatial support in the full image using an IoU-based reward. The cue is removed at inference time, preserving the standard image-question interface while encouraging the model to internalize local evidence search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations across fine-grained perception, hallucination, general understanding, and reasoning benchmarks. LOCUS improves localization-sensitive visual understanding while preserving broader capabilities, with attention analyses suggesting stronger focus on local evidence. Model size, data scale, baselines, and numerical gains are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 attention 分析；若效果成立，它把细粒度 VLM 的瓶颈从分辨率改写成证据检索。
recommendation.en: Read the method and attention analysis; if the results hold, it reframes fine-grained VLM failure as evidence search, not resolution.

paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in cross-modal reasoning, they often struggle to perceive fine-grained details in complex high-resolution images. Recent training-free methods address this through image scaling and localized cropping. However, applying these manipulations indiscriminately introduces computational redundancy for simple queries and can degrade accuracy by truncating essential global context or introducing irrelevant background noise. To this end, we propose Laz

summary.importance: 方法创新，提出动态自适应的训练-free视觉grounding框架，兼顾简单样本的推理效率和困难样本的精度
summary.technical_approach: 设计自适应路由模块，用单次前向的首token统计量评估预测不确定性，结合共形校准筛选困难样本；对困难样本用协作grounding模块融合跨模态注意力和多尺度裁剪结果

summary.authors_note: 腾讯BAC、清华大学深圳国际研究生院、北京大学、格拉斯哥大学，无特别知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the computational redundancy, global context loss, and accuracy degradation caused by indiscriminate scaling/cropping in existing training-free visual grounding methods
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a dynamic adaptive training-free visual grounding framework that balances efficiency for simple samples and accuracy for hard samples
summary_en.technical_approach: Adaptive routing module evaluates predictive uncertainty via first-token statistics from a single forward pass, uses conformal calibration to select hard samples; collaborative grounding module fuses cross-modal attention and multi-scale crop results for hard samples
summary_en.experiments: Tested on high-resolution image visual grounding tasks; compared to existing training-free methods, achieves comparable accuracy with significantly lower compute cost, or improves hard sample recall under the same compute budget
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent BAC, Tsinghua SIGS, Peking University, University of Glasgow; no well-known researchers identified

recommendation.zh: 多模态推理时的自适应路由策略，仅看§3.1的不确定性估计方法即可，与预训练方法本身无直接关联
recommendation.en: Adaptive routing strategy for multimodal inference; only §3.1 on uncertainty estimation is worth reviewing, with no direct relevance to pretraining methodology

paper.title: Pixel-TTS: Image based Text Rendering for Robust Text-to-Speech
paper.abstract: Recent advances in pixel-based text modeling show that representing text as images enables models to exploit visual cues for language understanding. Grounding text in its visual form allows structurally similar characters with different Unicode encodings to produce similar embeddings, benefiting cross-lingual and zero-shot scenarios. Conventional text-based approaches treat each character independently, limiting generalization to unseen characters and requiring embedding expansion during cross-l

summary.core_problem: 传统字符级 TTS 依赖独立字符嵌入，在跨语言、未见字符与字形变体场景下泛化差，且跨语言微调需扩展嵌入矩阵。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出视觉接地的 TTS 框架，将文本渲染为图像作为输入，为低资源/跨语言语音合成提供了不依赖 Unicode 字符表的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pixel-TTS：先把输入文本渲染为像素图像，再通过 2D 卷积层投影得到序列嵌入，替代传统字符嵌入层；后续接标准 TTS 声学/声码器模块。
summary.experiments: 在多语言 TTS 基准上与强基线对比，取得可比的合成质量；训练收敛更快，在未见字符与零样本跨语言场景下表现更鲁棒。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional character-level TTS uses independent character embeddings, limiting generalization to unseen characters, orthographic variants, and cross-lingual transfer while requiring embedding matrix expansion during fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Methodological novelty: the first visually-grounded TTS framework that takes rendered text images as input, offering a Unicode-vocabulary-agnostic path for low-resource and cross-lingual speech synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pixel-TTS renders input text into pixel images and projects them into sequence embeddings via a 2D convolutional layer, replacing the standard character embedding table before the acoustic and vocoder stages.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves competitive speech quality against strong baselines on multilingual TTS benchmarks, with faster convergence and improved robustness on unseen characters and zero-shot cross-lingual settings.

recommendation.zh: 用图像替代字符嵌入的思路对统一多模态 tokenizer 有弱启发，TTS 领域外价值有限，扫一眼方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Replacing character embeddings with rendered images gives weak hints for unified multimodal tokenizers; limited value outside TTS, skim the method figure only.

summary.authors_note: 无法从现有信息确认机构与知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have poor generalization under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, being distracted by irrelevant visual regions and affected by instruction ambiguity.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a general framework to simplify the training interface of VLA models, improving generalization without extra region annotations.

recommendation.en: This is a training interface optimization work in robotic VLA domain, with no direct insights for LLM base pretraining, only for general domain awareness.

paper.title: Decomposed On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Reasoning: Steering Gradients for Visual Grounding

summary.core_problem: 纯文本领域成熟的在线蒸馏（on-policy distillation）直接迁移到多模态场景时，存在未被探明的优化冲突：语言分布对齐和视觉 grounding 两个目标的梯度近似正交，标准单目标优化会被动走次优的妥协轨迹，无法保障足够的视觉感知对齐精度；同时现有VLM蒸馏普遍仅对文本部分做蒸馏，忽略视觉对齐需求。
summary.importance: 这是首个从梯度几何层面分析多模态在线蒸馏优化动态的工作，为多模态蒸馏的目标解耦、优化方向设计提供了可落地的依据；其发现的跨模态梯度子空间正交的分析范式，也可迁移到其他多任务、多模态联合优化的预训练与对齐场景。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将在线蒸馏的序列级反向KL损失数学分解为语言先验对齐、视觉 grounding 两个独立分量，通过梯度分析验证二者的梯度向量近似正交；随后提出视觉梯度引导（VGS）更新规则，动态调整优化轨迹，优先向与教师模型视觉信息增益对齐的子空间更新，在不损失语言流畅度的前提下强化视觉 grounding 能力，几乎无额外训练开销。
summary.experiments: 公开的全文片段未披露完整实验数值，仅明确VGS在复杂多模态推理基准上性能优于标准单目标在线蒸馏，且无显著额外训练成本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看引言部分的问题提出与图2的梯度几何分析，再了解视觉梯度引导的算法定义，预计阅读时间15-20分钟；关注多模态优化动态的研究者可深挖梯度分析部分的推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct application of standard monolithic on-policy distillation from text-only domains to vision-language models faces an uncharacterized optimization tension: gradients from the language prior alignment objective and the visual grounding objective are nearly orthogonal. Standard single-objective optimization thus passively follows a suboptimal compromise trajectory that fails to enforce sufficient perceptual fidelity, while most existing VLM distillation works only distill text components and neglect visual alignment requirements.
summary_en.importance: This is the first gradient-level geometric analysis of on-policy distillation in multimodal settings. Its finding of orthogonal gradient subspaces across modalities provides an actionable framework for decomposing multimodal training objectives, and the analysis paradigm can be generalized to other multi-task or cross-modal pretraining and alignment scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, it mathematically decomposes the sequence-level reverse KL loss of on-policy distillation into two independent components: language prior alignment and visual grounding. Gradient analysis confirms the two components have nearly orthogonal gradient vectors. It then proposes Visual Gradient Steering (VGS), an update rule that dynamically reorients the optimization trajectory to prioritize alignment with the teacher's visual information gain, improving visual grounding without degrading linguistic fluency, with negligible training overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text fragment does not include complete experimental metrics. The paper states VGS outperforms standard monolithic on-policy distillation on complex multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with no significant additional training cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for problem formulation and Figure 2 for gradient geometric analysis, then review the formulation of Visual Gradient Steering. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Researchers focused on multimodal optimization dynamics can dig into the derivations of the gradient analysis section.

recommendation.zh: 通过干预梯度来强化VLM的图文对齐，思路比较直接，对多模态post-training中如何利用teacher model的隐式知识有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Strengthening VLM image-text alignment by intervening in gradients is a straightforward approach, offering some reference value for how to utilize implicit knowledge from teacher models in multimodal post-training.

paper.title: Attend to Evidence: Evidence-Anchored Spatial Attention Supervision for Multimodal RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language models (VLMs) by optimizing outcome rewards derived from final answers. However, such outcome-only rewards do not tell the model which image regions justify an answer. For questions that require visual grounding, these rewards cannot distinguish responses supported by relevant visual evidence from those produced by language-prior shortcuts or lucky guesses. We introduce EASE (Evidence-Anchored Spatial Attention), whic

summary.core_problem: EASE 解决的是多模态 RLVR 中的视觉证据 credit assignment 问题。只用最终答案奖励时，VLM 可以因为语言先验、数据偏置或猜测得到正确答案，但并不一定看到了支持答案的图像区域。对于小物体、局部属性、空间关系、多区域比较和计数类问题，最终奖励无法区分“看对了再答对”和“没看对但碰巧答对”。
summary.importance: 这项工作属于 VLM post-training，但对预训练和统一多模态建模有启发。它指出多模态 RL 的关键瓶颈不只是 reward 是否可验证，还包括 reward 是否能把监督传到视觉证据获取过程。对基座研究的意义在于：视觉 token 与文本 response token 之间的注意力分配可以作为训练信号，而不是只作为可解释性诊断；证据框这类 privileged label 可以只在训练时使用，不改变推理接口。这种做法为后续 native multimodal pretrain / mid-train 提供了一个思路：在不引入额外推理输入的前提下，让模型学会更稳定地把生成过程锚定到视觉证据。
summary.technical_approach: EASE 在 outcome-based multimodal RL 上增加视觉证据过程监督。方法先把人工标注的 evidence boxes 映射成视觉 token 上的平滑目标分布。训练时，模型生成 response token，EASE 约束这些 response token 对图像 token 的 attention 分布，使其更接近证据目标。这个正则只施加在高奖励轨迹上，因为低奖励回答中的注意力模式可能对应错误推理或错误证据，直接监督会引入噪声。证据标注只作为训练期 privileged target，推理时不需要输入框、坐标或 grounding tag。相比让模型显式输出坐标或视觉思维链，EASE 的改动更小：它不改变输出格式，而是通过内部 attention 对齐改善证据获取。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-4B、Qwen3-VL-8B 上验证 EASE。按与 DAPO 相同的训练和评测协议，平均分分别提升 2.9、3.1、2.5 分。收益出现在 perception-heavy reasoning、hallucination robustness、visual math 和 logic benchmark 上。诊断实验使用 HallusionBench-Image 的 evidence-localizable 样本，计算 response-to-vision attention 与证据目标之间的 KL divergence。结果显示 KL 越大，幻觉风险越高；幻觉回答的 KL 分布也高于非幻觉回答。消融结果支持几个设计选择：只对高奖励轨迹加证据监督优于无门控监督；平滑目标优于硬区域目标；混合 single-evidence 和 multi-evidence 数据有助于模型同时学习局部聚焦和多区域覆盖。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 perception credit assignment 的定义，这决定了论文的动机是否成立。再看 Method 部分，重点核对三件事：evidence box 如何投影到 visual tokens，attention loss 加在哪些层或哪些 response token 上，高奖励轨迹的 gating 阈值如何设定。实验部分重点看 Figure 3 的 KL—hallucination 诊断，以及与 DAPO 对齐协议下的三组 backbone 结果。若做多模态预训练或 RLVR，值得进一步看消融：attention supervision 的位置、权重、平滑半径、多证据样本比例，这些细节会决定方法是否能迁移到更大规模训练。

summary_en.core_problem: EASE targets the visual-evidence credit assignment problem in multimodal RLVR. Outcome rewards can tell whether the final answer is correct, but they do not identify which image regions should support that answer. A VLM may answer correctly through language priors, dataset bias, or chance, especially on questions involving small objects, localized attributes, spatial relations, counting, or evidence spread across multiple regions.
summary_en.importance: The paper is a VLM post-training work, but it has clear relevance to multimodal foundation-model training. It argues that verifiable rewards are not enough when the missing signal lies in perception rather than final reasoning. The useful idea is to use evidence annotations as privileged training-only supervision for response-to-image attention, without changing the inference interface. This provides a practical bridge between outcome RL and grounded multimodal representation learning, and suggests that internal cross-modal attention can be trained as a process signal rather than only inspected after training.
summary_en.technical_approach: EASE augments outcome-based multimodal RL with evidence-anchored process supervision. Annotated evidence boxes are converted into a smoothed target distribution over visual tokens. During actor updates, the method regularizes the attention from generated response tokens to image tokens so that it better matches this target. The regularizer is applied only to high-reward trajectories, because low-reward responses may have unreliable or misleading attention patterns. The evidence boxes are not used at inference time. Compared with methods that ask the model to output coordinates, grounding tags, or explicit visual traces, EASE keeps the response format unchanged and trains the internal attention pathway instead.
summary_en.experiments: EASE is evaluated on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B, and Qwen3-VL-8B. Under the same protocol as DAPO, it improves the average score by 2.9, 3.1, and 2.5 points on these backbones. The reported gains cover perception-heavy reasoning, hallucination robustness, visual math, and multimodal logic benchmarks. A diagnostic study on evidence-localizable HallusionBench-Image examples measures the KL divergence between response-to-vision attention and the evidence target. Higher KL is associated with higher hallucination risk, and hallucinated responses show larger KL than non-hallucinated ones. Ablations support reward-aware gating, smoothed evidence targets, and training on both single-evidence and multi-evidence examples.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Start with the motivation around perception credit assignment, then read the method details on mapping boxes to visual-token targets, selecting response-to-image attention, and gating by high reward. The most useful experimental pieces are the KL-versus-hallucination diagnostic and the backbone-by-backbone comparison under the DAPO protocol. For readers working on multimodal pretraining or RLVR, the ablations on attention-loss placement, target smoothing, evidence mixture, and loss weighting are the parts most likely to transfer to larger training runs.

recommendation.zh: 将视觉 grounding 作为 process supervision 引入 RLVR 的思路很漂亮，通过 attention 引导解决多模态 RL 中的捷径学习问题，值得关注其 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: The idea of introducing visual grounding as process supervision into RLVR is elegant. Guiding attention to solve shortcut learning in multimodal RL is worth noting, especially the loss design.

paper.title: iVGR: Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning for MLLMs with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: While visually grounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has emerged as a promising paradigm to enhance fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), its efficacy during the inference phase remains underexplored. In this work, we empirically find that mandating explicit object boxes in visually grounded CoT during inference often degrades performance compared to standard textual CoT, which reasons without explicit visual grounding. We hypothesize that the visual localization capabil

summary.core_problem: iVGR 研究的是多模态大模型中的视觉落地推理是否应该在推理期显式输出框或调用裁剪工具。论文的核心发现是：显式 grounding 能训练出定位能力，但推理期强制输出框往往会干扰答案生成；更好的方式可能是把定位能力内化到文本 CoT 中。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 post-train 和 multimodal pretrain/post-train 接口有启发。它指出视觉 grounding 不一定要以显式坐标形式出现在最终推理轨迹里。坐标、裁剪、框监督可以作为训练信号，用来塑造模型的注意和局部感知能力；但推理期目标仍应围绕答案质量和稳定性。这个结论对构造 MLLM 的 RL 训练信号很有用：辅助能力可以通过奖励和一致性约束迁移到主轨迹，而不是让模型在部署时同时承担辅助任务和主任务。
summary.technical_approach: iVGR 采用双流强化学习训练。对同一个图文问题，策略模型生成两类 rollout：grounded stream 输出带 bounding box 的视觉落地 CoT，textual stream 输出普通文本 CoT。训练中先从 grounded stream 中筛选高质量轨迹，再用 consistency reward 约束 textual stream，使文本 CoT 与高质量 grounded 推理保持一致。这样模型在训练期利用显式定位信号学习“看哪里”，但在测试期可以不输出坐标，减少格式负担和错误框带来的噪声。论文还保留了与 crop tool 的兼容性：在细粒度 VQA 中，模型仍可在需要时调用裁剪流程，但默认推理不被强制绑定到显式框输出。
summary.experiments: 论文先做了一个诊断实验：对 DeepEyes 和 TreeVGR 这类已训练过视觉落地 CoT 的模型，只改变推理 prompt，不重新训练，比较 grounded CoT 与普通 textual CoT。结果显示，grounded CoT 虽然优于基础 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，但 textual CoT 在多数 VQA benchmark 上更好。进一步的 HR8K IoU 分组分析显示：对 crop-based 方法，只有定位质量较高时 grounded CoT 才占优；定位差时，错误裁剪会引入视觉噪声。对 box-based 方法，显式框输出在各个 IoU 区间都不如 textual CoT，说明坐标生成本身可能抢占了推理预算。随后，iVGR 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Qwen3-VL 上训练，并在多个 VQA benchmark 上取得一致提升。可见内容没有给出完整分数表，具体涨幅应查看实验表和消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中关于 grounded CoT 与 textual CoT 的对照实验，以及 Figure 2 的 IoU-accuracy 分析，这是论文最有信息量的动机部分。方法部分重点看 dual-stream rollout、grounded trajectory 选择标准、consistency reward 的定义。实验部分建议看三组消融：没有 consistency reward、只用 grounded stream、只用 textual stream。若关注 MLLM RL 训练，还应看 reward 是否依赖答案正确性、定位质量、格式约束，以及这些奖励之间是否存在冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: iVGR asks whether multimodal models should explicitly output boxes or use crop tools during inference for visually grounded reasoning. The main observation is that explicit grounding can be useful as a training signal, but forcing the model to emit boxes at inference often interferes with answer prediction. The paper argues that localization ability should be internalized into textual chain-of-thought.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for understanding the interface between multimodal post-training and inference behavior. It separates auxiliary supervision from the final reasoning format. Box prediction, cropping, and grounding can teach the model where to look, but the deployed reasoning trace does not need to expose these intermediate coordinates. This is a practical lesson for RL training of MLLMs: auxiliary capabilities can be transferred into the main textual trajectory through rewards and consistency constraints, instead of making the model solve the auxiliary task and the answer task at the same time during inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: iVGR uses a dual-stream reinforcement learning setup. For each image-question pair, the policy model produces two types of rollouts: a grounded stream with explicit bounding boxes in the reasoning trace, and a textual stream with ordinary natural-language reasoning. High-quality grounded trajectories are selected and used as references for a consistency reward. This reward encourages the textual stream to align with grounded reasoning without requiring explicit coordinates at test time. The model therefore learns localization behavior during training, but avoids coordinate-format burden and noisy localization errors during inference. The method also remains compatible with crop-tool workflows for fine-grained VQA when tool use is beneficial.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first presents a diagnostic study on existing grounded-reasoning models such as DeepEyes and TreeVGR. Without retraining, the authors change only the inference prompt and compare grounded CoT with textual CoT. Grounded CoT improves over the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, but textual CoT performs better on most VQA benchmarks. An IoU-based analysis on HR8K further explains the pattern. For crop-based reasoning, grounded CoT helps only when localization is accurate; poor crops introduce visual noise. For box-based reasoning, explicit box generation underperforms textual CoT across IoU groups, suggesting that coordinate prediction itself can distract from answer prediction. iVGR is then trained on Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL and reports consistent gains across multiple VQA benchmarks. The visible content does not include the full numeric tables, so exact improvements should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the diagnostic comparison between grounded CoT and textual CoT in the introduction, then inspect the IoU-accuracy analysis around Figure 2. These parts carry the main insight. In the method section, focus on dual-stream rollout generation, the selection of high-quality grounded trajectories, and the definition of the consistency reward. In the experiments, look for ablations removing the consistency reward, using only grounded trajectories, or using only textual trajectories. For readers interested in MLLM RL, the key point is how answer rewards, localization rewards, and format constraints interact.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是那个负结果：显式 grounding 可能干扰 answer objective；先看主表和 ablation，若 setup 干净，会直接影响你设计 MLLM RL 信号。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the negative result: explicit grounding may interfere with answer prediction; check the main table and ablations first, because if the setup is clean it changes how you design RL signals for MLLMs.

paper.title: Mitigating Hallucination in Vision-Language Models through Barrier-Regulated Adaptive Closed-form Steering
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate objects that are not present in the input image, largely because visual grounding weakens as decoding progresses. Existing inference-time mitigation methods modify logits or hidden states throughout generation, but they suffer from three key limitations: they lack an explicit grounding objective, intervene even when the model is already well-grounded, and use fixed correction strengths that do not adapt to the severity of grounding failure.

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型(LVLM)在解码过程中视觉接地逐渐减弱，导致幻觉出图像中不存在的对象
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需训练的推理时幻觉缓解方法，属于LVLM对齐的推理时间干预
summary.technical_approach: BRACS：屏障调节的自适应闭环转向框架，通过监测模型注意力度量视觉接地状态，仅当地基恶化时以闭形式计算修正量并应用于隐藏状态，无需训练辅助网络
summary.experiments: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen-VL-Chat上验证，相比现有推理时缓解方法，在多个LVLM hallucination benchmark上有改进

summary_en.core_problem: Large vision-language models hallucinate objects not present in the input image because visual grounding weakens as decoding progresses
summary_en.importance: Training-free inference-time hallucination mitigation method for LVLMs; a form of inference-time alignment intervention
summary_en.technical_approach: BRACS: Barrier-Regulated Adaptive Closed-form Steering; monitors attention to measure visual grounding, applies closed-form hidden-state corrections only when grounding deteriorates; no auxiliary network training needed
summary_en.experiments: Validated on LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen-VL-Chat; improves over existing inference-time mitigation methods on multiple LVLM hallucination benchmarks

recommendation.zh: LVLM幻觉的推理时干预方法，核心insight是用注意力自身监测接地质量并自适应修正，但方法本身不涉及预训练建模，作为相关工作备查
recommendation.en: Inference-time intervention for LVLM hallucination using self-attention for adaptive correction; does not address pretrain modeling, worth knowing but not reading deeply

paper.title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) commonly formulate visual grounding and detection as a coordinate-token generation problem, serializing each 2D box into multiple 1D tokens that are learned and decoded largely independently. This token-by-token decoding mismatches the coupled structure of box geometry and creates a practical inference bottleneck due to strictly sequential generation. We introduce LocateAnything, a unified generative grounding and detection framework based on Parallel Box Decoding (

summary.core_problem: VLM 用 next-token 方式生成坐标时，把一个 2D box 序列化成多个 token，导致两类问题：几何耦合被打散（精度与一致性受损），以及严格自回归带来推理延迟与吞吐瓶颈。论文要解决的是“既快又稳”的生成式 grounding/detection 解码。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响中等偏低，但对“tokenization/输出表示如何决定训练目标与推理效率”很具体：它把 MTP（multi-token prediction）从通用 token 流的并行预测，改成与结构单元对齐的 block 预测，属于一种输出空间的结构化建模。对做多模态统一 LM、坐标/布局/GUI grounding、以及希望把检测纳入生成式范式的人，这类 block-aligned 目标比单纯加速解码（如 speculative）更贴近建模问题本身。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是 Parallel Box Decoding (PBD)：
1) 结构单元对齐：训练时把一个 box（或 point）视为原子单元，在一个并行步骤里联合预测 (x1,y1,x2,y2)，而不是把坐标拆成 1D token 串逐个生成。这样显式建模 box 内部强耦合，避免通用 MTP/随机 mask 造成“跨 box 边界的错误相关”。
2) 训练目标：同时兼容 NTP（自回归逐 token）与 block-level MTP（逐 box 并行），用 joint training 让模型既能并行出结果，也保留必要时回退到稳定的自回归能力。
3) 推理三模式：Fast（全并行 box 预测，最大吞吐）、Slow（传统 NTP，最大稳定）、Hybrid（默认 Fast，检测到格式/一致性违规时，对问题 block 局部回退 NTP 重解码）。Hybrid 的关键在于“只修坏块”，避免全局回退导致的最坏时延。
从系统角度，它把 grounding 的输出从“token 序列”提升为“结构化块序列”，并把可靠性控制做成可配置策略。
summary.experiments: 从引言可确认的量化结论只有：最高约 2.5× 解码吞吐提升，同时提升定位质量；评测覆盖 layout grounding、long-tail detection、GUI grounding。你提供的全文片段未包含实验表格与设置，无法可靠给出：具体基座（如 Qwen2.5-VL/InternVL3 等哪一个）、训练数据规模、mAP/IoU/pointing accuracy 的提升幅度、Hybrid 触发率与最坏时延、以及 PBD 对不同 box 数量/分辨率的 scaling 行为。若补充实验章节，建议重点抽取：Fast vs Slow vs Hybrid 的速度-精度曲线、以及“跨 box 边界 spurious correlation”在消融中的定量证据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Fig.1/2（坐标序列化的问题与 spurious correlation 示例），建立它为什么不满足几何结构。
- 方法部分重点读：PBD 的输出格式、block 的定义（box/point）、joint training 如何把 NTP 与 MTP 对齐。
- 直接跳到 Hybrid 的“不可靠检测”规则与局部回退机制，这是落地时最关键的工程细节。
- 实验部分优先看速度-精度曲线与消融：PBD vs 逐 token、Hybrid 的触发策略、以及不同任务（GUI/layout/long-tail）的一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Generative grounding/detection in VLMs typically serializes a 2D box into multiple 1D tokens and decodes them autoregressively, which (i) breaks the strong geometric coupling within a box and (ii) creates a strict sequential decoding bottleneck. The paper targets a speed–quality trade-off that is acceptable for interactive/embodied use.
summary_en.importance: Moderate relevance to foundation-model training: the main contribution is not a new pretraining recipe, but a concrete demonstration that output representation (tokenization of geometry) and training objective alignment can simultaneously improve accuracy and inference throughput. For multimodal LMs that must emit structured outputs (boxes, points, layouts, UI elements), block-aligned prediction is a more modeling-native lever than purely decoding-time accelerations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LocateAnything introduces Parallel Box Decoding (PBD):
1) Box-aligned blocks: treat each bounding box (or point) as an atomic unit and predict the full coordinate tuple (x1, y1, x2, y2) in one parallel step, instead of token-by-token coordinate generation.
2) Joint training: align autoregressive next-token prediction (NTP) with block-level multi-token prediction (MTP), so the model can operate in both regimes.
3) On-demand inference: three modes—Fast (parallel box decoding), Slow (fully autoregressive for robustness), and Hybrid (default Fast, but detect unreliable blocks—format/consistency violations—and locally fall back to NTP only for those blocks). The design goal is to keep most of the throughput gains while avoiding worst-case failures.
Conceptually, it upgrades the output space from a flat token stream to structured blocks and couples it with a reliability-aware decoding policy.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided excerpt, the only concrete number is up to ~2.5× higher decoding throughput while improving localization quality; evaluations include layout grounding, long-tail detection, and GUI grounding. The excerpt does not include the experimental section, so I cannot report exact datasets, base models, training scale, mAP/IoU gains, Hybrid fallback rates, or latency distributions. With the full results, the most important evidence to extract would be: (i) speed–accuracy curves across Fast/Slow/Hybrid, (ii) ablations showing reduced cross-box spurious correlations, and (iii) scaling behavior with number of boxes and image resolution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Start with the motivating figures (coordinate serialization and spurious correlations) to understand why generic MTP is a mismatch.
- In the method, focus on the exact block definition and how PBD is trained alongside NTP.
- Read the Hybrid reliability checks and localized fallback logic; this is the key production-facing detail.
- In experiments, prioritize speed–accuracy plots and ablations comparing PBD vs token-level decoding across GUI/layout/long-tail settings.

recommendation.zh: 挑战了 VLM 中主流的自回归坐标 token 化范式，提出的并行解码（作为原子单元）对多模态统一表示和输出头设计有启发，值得看其架构设计。
recommendation.en: Challenges the mainstream autoregressive coordinate tokenization paradigm in VLMs; the proposed parallel decoding (as atomic units) offers insights for unified multimodal representation and output head design, making its architecture worth reviewing.

paper.title: Reading or Guessing? Visual Grounding Failures of Vision-Language Models for OCR in Ancient Greek Editions
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) used for optical character recognition (OCR) can generate plausible but visually unsupported text, suggesting reliance on language priors. Comparing open-weight VLMs with traditional OCR baselines on low-resource Ancient Greek critical editions, we show that VLM errors often remain fluent even when wrong, producing plausible Greek substitutions where traditional engines produce local recognition noise. To analyze visual evidence during dec

summary.core_problem: VLM 在 OCR 场景中可能不是逐字读取图像，而是用语言先验生成流畅但视觉证据不足的文本，尤其在低资源古希腊校勘本上更明显。
summary.importance: 这是 VLM grounding failure 的分析工作。贡献不是新模型，而是用受控图像扰动和 token-level grounding 指标拆分视觉证据与语言先验，对 VLM 预训练中的视觉依赖、OCR 数据质量和幻觉评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较 open-weight VLM 与传统 OCR baseline，并引入字符级图像扰动；同时用 conditional decoding distribution 与 image-free decoding distribution 的差异度量 token 对图像的依赖程度。这个设计试图区分模型是真的看图，还是在根据语言模型先验补全 plausible Greek text。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是低资源 Ancient Greek critical editions。摘要报告：VLM 错误通常仍保持流畅，倾向产生 plausible Greek substitutions；传统 OCR 错误更像局部识别噪声。字符级扰动下，VLM 会明显偏离扰动后的 ground truth，而传统 OCR 相对更忠实。token-level 分析显示先验依赖具有模型特异性：OCR-specialist model 的流畅词汇错误可在很少依赖图像的情况下产生；general-purpose VLM 的行为与之不同，但摘要后半句被截断，具体方向需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether VLMs performing OCR actually read the image or instead generate fluent text from language priors, focusing on low-resource Ancient Greek critical editions.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis of VLM grounding failures rather than a new model. Its contribution is a controlled perturbation and token-level grounding setup that separates visual evidence from language priors, which is relevant for VLM pretraining data quality, OCR grounding, and hallucination evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare open-weight VLMs with traditional OCR baselines, introduce character-level image perturbations, and measure token grounding through the gap between conditional decoding distributions and image-free decoding distributions. The goal is to tell whether a model is reading the image or completing plausible Greek text from its language model prior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use low-resource Ancient Greek critical editions. The abstract reports that VLM errors often remain fluent and produce plausible Greek substitutions, whereas traditional OCR errors look more like local recognition noise. Under character-level perturbations, VLMs diverge sharply from the perturbed ground truth while traditional OCR remains more faithful. Token-level analysis shows model-specific prior reliance: an OCR-specialist model can produce fluent lexical errors with little image reliance; the behavior of general-purpose VLMs is described further but truncated in the supplied abstract.

recommendation.zh: 看方法里的 image-free 对照即可；任务很窄，但这个 grounding probe 可复用到多模态预训练评估。
recommendation.en: Read the image-free control setup; the task is narrow, but the grounding probe is reusable for multimodal pretraining evaluation.

We introduce LocateAnything, a unified generative grounding and detection framework based on Parallel Box Decoding (

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型把 grounding 和 detection 表述为坐标 token 的串行生成，既破坏 box 几何元素之间的耦合，也带来解码延迟。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 VLM grounding 的建模和工程改进：把 box/point 从多个独立坐标 token 改为原子几何单元并行解码，同时配套构建 1.38 亿样本级 LocateAnything-Data，用于提升开放定位数据覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Parallel Box Decoding，将边界框、点等几何结构作为一次性解码的单元，而不是按坐标 token 自回归展开。方法的关键是让模型在同一步内预测几何元素，保留框内几何一致性，并减少严格串行生成带来的推理瓶颈。另有可扩展数据引擎用于收集和整理大规模定位训练样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露训练数据超过 1.38 亿样本，并报告 PBD 同时提升解码吞吐和定位准确率；具体模型规模、baseline 名称、数据配比和提升幅度未在给定摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLM grounding and detection systems often serialize each box into coordinate tokens, which weakens geometric coupling and creates an autoregressive decoding bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM grounding method plus a large data asset: boxes and points are decoded as atomic geometric units, and LocateAnything-Data provides more than 138M training samples for high-precision localization.
summary_en.technical_approach: LocateAnything introduces Parallel Box Decoding, predicting geometric objects such as boxes and points in one step instead of emitting coordinate tokens sequentially. This preserves intra-box consistency and exposes parallelism. The work also builds a scalable data engine to improve localization data diversity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports over 138M training samples and claims gains in both decoding throughput and localization accuracy. Model sizes, baselines, and exact improvement numbers are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不是主线；只看 PBD 如何替代坐标 token 串行生成，以及 1.38 亿定位数据的构造信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim only the PBD replacement for serialized coordinate tokens and the 138M-sample grounding data engine.

paper.title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iteratively predicting tokens at multiple masked positions in parallel. This turns each decoding step into a position-selection problem: the model must choose not only which predictions are reliable in isolation, but also which positions should be committed together as context for later decoding steps. summary.core_problem: 现有扩散多模态大模型的并行解码策略独立选择高置信度token，忽略视觉grounding重叠引入的冗余，降低后续解码的互补视觉信息利用率
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出量化并行解码视觉冗余的指标，设计对应的冗余控制解码策略，提升扩散多模态模型生成质量
summary.technical_approach: 提出视觉冗余指数（VRI）量化同一步提交token的视觉grounding重叠程度，设计视觉冗余控制的并行解码算法，优先选择视觉信息互补的token组合提交为上下文
summary.experiments: 在扩散多模态大模型上验证，相比基线置信度解码方法，生成准确性和视觉grounding一致性有明确提升，摘要未披露具体模型参数量和提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing parallel decoding strategies for diffusion-based multimodal large language models select high-confidence tokens independently, ignoring redundancy caused by overlapping visual grounding, which reduces utilization of complementary visual information in subsequent decoding steps
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first proposes a metric to quantify visual redundancy in parallel decoding, and designs a corresponding redundancy-controlled decoding strategy to improve generation quality of diffusion multimodal models
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Visual Redundancy Index (VRI) to quantify visual grounding overlap of tokens committed in the same decoding step, design a visual-redundancy-controlled parallel decoding algorithm that prioritizes committing token sets with complementary visual information as context

We observe that standard on-policy distillation can improve a student's output quality while failing to strengthen its reliance on visual input: on vision-critical tokens, the student's predictions remain largely unchanged whether or not fine-grained visual detail is present, even though the teacher's predictions depend heavily on it.To make this

summary.core_problem: 标准在策略蒸馏应用到视觉语言模型（VLM）时，均匀加权的KL损失会被大量不依赖视觉信息的语言脚手架token稀释，学生模型仅能表面对齐教师输出，无法真正增强对细粒度视觉信息的依赖，视觉关键token的梯度贡献被严重弱化。
summary.importance: 为多模态模型蒸馏提供了token级的视觉依赖量化信号，避免蒸馏仅对齐语言表面特征，对VLM预训练后的蒸馏压缩、多模态对齐有实际参考价值，方法轻量无需额外标注或额外训练组件。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出视觉优势（VA）的量化指标：对学生生成的每个token，计算教师模型在有细粒度视觉信息、无细粒度视觉信息两种条件下打分的对数概率差，用来表征每个token的视觉依赖程度。基于VA提出VA-OPD蒸馏方法，从两个粒度优化损失：1）轨迹层面，同prompt下生成的多个候选rollout按轨迹平均VA加权，视觉依赖更强的rollout梯度贡献更高；2）token层面，按VA将token分为高低两组，组内分别平均KL损失后再求和，避免高VA关键token的梯度被低VA语言token稀释。整个方案仅增加一次教师模型在退化图像上的前向传播，无额外标注、奖励模型或更多rollout的开销。
summary.experiments: 在4B/8B/32B三种教师规模、Geometry3K和ViRL39K两个训练语料、8个基准测试上验证，VA-OPD在所有基准上均超过标准在策略蒸馏。细粒度视觉依赖越强的任务提升越明显：HallusionBench提升2.5，AI2D提升2.4；使用更大规模的ViRL39K语料时，数学类任务平均提升3.8，视觉类任务平均提升2.5。训练过程中学生rollout的VA值与准确率同步上升，证明性能提升来自对视觉信息依赖的增强，而非单纯模仿教师的输出表面特征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Introduction部分的问题观察、VA指标定义，以及实验章节中移除高VA token损失的消融实验，可跳过具体训练超参数细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When standard on-policy distillation is applied to vision-language models (VLMs), the uniformly weighted KL loss is diluted by a large volume of language scaffolding tokens that do not rely on visual input. The student model only aligns with the teacher's outputs at the surface level, failing to genuinely strengthen reliance on fine-grained visual details, with gradient contributions from vision-critical tokens heavily weakened.
summary_en.importance: It provides a token-level quantitative signal of visual dependency for multimodal model distillation, avoiding distillation that only aligns surface linguistic features. It has practical reference value for post-pretraining distillation, compression and multimodal alignment of VLMs, and the method is lightweight with no requirement for extra annotations or additional training components.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the Visual Advantage (VA) metric is proposed: for each token generated by the student, calculate the log-probability difference of the token scored by the teacher under two conditions (with fine-grained visual details, and with fine-grained visual details degraded), which characterizes the visual dependency level of each token. The VA-OPD distillation method is built on VA, with loss optimized at two granularities: 1) Trajectory level: multiple candidate rollouts generated under the same prompt are weighted by their trajectory-averaged VA, so rollouts with stronger visual dependency contribute more to the gradient. 2) Token level: tokens are divided into high and low VA groups by VA value, KL loss is averaged separately within each group before summation, to avoid gradient dilution of high-VA critical tokens by low-VA linguistic tokens. The whole pipeline only adds one extra teacher forward pass on degraded images, with no extra cost of annotations, reward models or additional rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 3 teacher sizes (4B/8B/32B), 2 training corpora (Geometry3K, ViRL39K) and 8 benchmarks, VA-OPD outperforms standard on-policy distillation on all benchmarks. Gains are more significant on tasks with higher fine-grained visual dependency: +2.5 on HallusionBench, +2.4 on AI2D. When using the larger ViRL39K corpus, the average gain on math tasks reaches 3.8, and the average gain on visual tasks reaches 2.5. The VA value of student rollouts rises synchronously with accuracy during training, proving performance gains come from enhanced reliance on visual information, rather than mere imitation of surface features of teacher outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem observation and VA metric definition in the Introduction section, as well as the ablation experiment of removing loss on high-VA tokens in the experiment section. Specific training hyperparameter details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是训练信号分解思路，不是蒸馏本身；只看VA定义和高VA token分布，如果现象稳，很多多模态loss都该重写。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the supervision decomposition, not distillation per se; read the VA definition and token distribution first—if the effect is robust, many multimodal losses are underweighting the only tokens that matter.
